lines.text: في مَعْرِفة الأَشْكال التِّسْعة التي تكون للكواكب الثابتة وبعض المتحيِّرة عند الشمس.
lines.plain: في مَعْرِفة الأَشْكال التِّسْعة التي تكون للكواكب الثابتة وبعض المتحيِّرة عند الشمس.

lines.text: قال ولأنّ مَدار الكواكب الثابتة والمتحيِّرة في مسيرها على قُطْبَيْ فَلَك البُروج [مُنْذُ عُلِمَتْ{mR:5}
lines.plain: قال ولأنّ مَدار الكواكب الثابتة والمتحيِّرة في مسيرها على قُطْبَيْ فَلَك البُروج [مُنْذُ عُلِمَتْ

lines.text: حَرَكتها في الطول والعرض]{n:1} ومَدار الكُرَة المستقيمة على قُطْبَيْ مُعَدِّل النهار صار طُلوعها وغُروبها
lines.plain: حَرَكتها في الطول والعرض] ومَدار الكُرَة المستقيمة على قُطْبَيْ مُعَدِّل النهار صار طُلوعها وغُروبها

lines.text: من ناحِيَتَيْ خَطّ وَسَط السماء مُتَسَاوِيَيِ القَدْر في مَوْضِع معدِّل النهار ابدًا{n:2} لم يُعْلَمْ لحَرَكَتها تَغْيِير
lines.plain: من ناحِيَتَيْ خَطّ وَسَط السماء مُتَسَاوِيَيِ القَدْر في مَوْضِع معدِّل النهار ابدًا لم يُعْلَمْ لحَرَكَتها تَغْيِير

lines.text: أمّا في الأفْلاك المائلة عن فلك معدِّل النهار فإِنّه لا يكون طُلوعها وغُروبها من ناحِيَتَيْ خطّ وسط
lines.plain: أمّا في الأفْلاك المائلة عن فلك معدِّل النهار فإِنّه لا يكون طُلوعها وغُروبها من ناحِيَتَيْ خطّ وسط

lines.text: السماء بالسَّوِيَّة بَلْ يختلِف ذلك فتكون الجَنُوبيّة منها *أَبْطَأَ طُلوعًا من الشَّماليّة وكذلك تسبِق{mR:10}{mL:f. 121,v.}
lines.plain: السماء بالسَّوِيَّة بَلْ يختلِف ذلك فتكون الجَنُوبيّة منها *أَبْطَأَ طُلوعًا من الشَّماليّة وكذلك تسبِق

lines.text: بغُروبها ولذلك صار كلّ ما لم يكُنْ منها على نِطاق البُروج لا يَسْتَوِي طُلوعه وغُروبه وتوسُّطه السماء
lines.plain: بغُروبها ولذلك صار كلّ ما لم يكُنْ منها على نِطاق البُروج لا يَسْتَوِي طُلوعه وغُروبه وتوسُّطه السماء

lines.text: مع جُزْء واحد من أجزاء البروج بَلْ مع أجزاء مختلِفة فتختلف لذلك أشْكالها مع بعض الكواكب
lines.plain: مع جُزْء واحد من أجزاء البروج بَلْ مع أجزاء مختلِفة فتختلف لذلك أشْكالها مع بعض الكواكب

lines.text: الجارية وهي السَّيَّارة المتحيِّرة في نَوَاحي فلك البروج ونواحي الأُفْق ومع الشمس والقمر ايضًا وأظْهَرها
lines.plain: الجارية وهي السَّيَّارة المتحيِّرة في نَوَاحي فلك البروج ونواحي الأُفْق ومع الشمس والقمر ايضًا وأظْهَرها

lines.text: قُوَّةً التي يكون لها عند الشمس فيقَع ذلك على تِسْعة أصناف {ov:ا} فالصَّنْف الاوّل منها تشريق الغَدَوَات
lines.plain: قُوَّةً التي يكون لها عند الشمس فيقَع ذلك على تِسْعة أصناف ا فالصَّنْف الاوّل منها تشريق الغَدَوَات

lines.text: وذلك اذا كان الكوكب مع الشمس في أُفْق المشرِق وذلك على وَجْهَيْن احدهما يُدْعَى الصُّبْحِيَّ فهو{mR:15}
lines.plain: وذلك اذا كان الكوكب مع الشمس في أُفْق المشرِق وذلك على وَجْهَيْن احدهما يُدْعَى الصُّبْحِيَّ فهو

lines.text: أن يكون الكوكب غيْرَ ظاهر في المشرِق ثمّ يطلُع من بَعْدِ ذلك من بَعْد طُلوع الشمس والآخر يُدْعَى
lines.plain: أن يكون الكوكب غيْرَ ظاهر في المشرِق ثمّ يطلُع من بَعْدِ ذلك من بَعْد طُلوع الشمس والآخر يُدْعَى

lines.text: صُبْحِيَّ مَشْرِقٍ وذلك أنْ يطلُع مع الشمس من المشرِق وقد يُقال التشريق اذا طلَع الكوكب قَبْلَ
lines.plain: صُبْحِيَّ مَشْرِقٍ وذلك أنْ يطلُع مع الشمس من المشرِق وقد يُقال التشريق اذا طلَع الكوكب قَبْلَ

lines.text: الشمس. {ov:ب} والصَّنْف الثاني يُسَمَّى وَسَط سَماء التشريق وذلك اذا كان الكوكب عند طُلوع الشمس
lines.plain: الشمس. ب والصَّنْف الثاني يُسَمَّى وَسَط سَماء التشريق وذلك اذا كان الكوكب عند طُلوع الشمس

lines.text: على وسط السماء الذي من فَوْقِ الارض وتَحْتِها وهذا ايضًا على وَجْهَيْن احدهما الذي يُدْعَى صُبْحِيًّا
lines.plain: على وسط السماء الذي من فَوْقِ الارض وتَحْتِها وهذا ايضًا على وَجْهَيْن احدهما الذي يُدْعَى صُبْحِيًّا

lines.text: وهو أن يتوسَّط السماء بعد طُلوع الشمس والآخر يُدعَى صُبْحِيًّا مُتَوَسِّطًا وذلك أن يكون الكوكب في{mR:20}
lines.plain: وهو أن يتوسَّط السماء بعد طُلوع الشمس والآخر يُدعَى صُبْحِيًّا مُتَوَسِّطًا وذلك أن يكون الكوكب في

lines.text: وَسَط السماء والشمس في المشرِق. {ov:ج} والصَّنْف الثالث يُقال له تغريب الصُّبْح وذلك أن تكون
lines.plain: وَسَط السماء والشمس في المشرِق. ج والصَّنْف الثالث يُقال له تغريب الصُّبْح وذلك أن تكون

lines.text: الشمس في المطلَع والكوكب قَريب من أُفْق المغرِب وذلك ايضًا على وُجُوه شَتَّى منها أن يكون الكوكب
lines.plain: الشمس في المطلَع والكوكب قَريب من أُفْق المغرِب وذلك ايضًا على وُجُوه شَتَّى منها أن يكون الكوكب

notes.text: 1) Quae uncis sunt inclusa mihi inepta videntur; desunt apud Platonem. — 2) Cod. addit لما

observations: L03, L06, L07, L09, L12, L14, L18: long joins (مـدار, الثابتـة and مُنْـذُ on L03; مـن and خـطّ on L06; منهـا, مـن and تسبِـق on L07; مختلِفـة and the third مـع on L09; فهـو at the end of L12; طلَـع and قَبْـلَ on L14; يُقـال on L18) are not transcribed; nor the long kāf of حَرَكتها (L04) and of لحَرَكَتها (L05).

The page begins chapter 49. It has 19 lines and one line of notes. The heading stands on L01, in the larger type, centred (240.0 to 398.4 pt), and after a space the title on L02, centred as well (144.9 to 494.8 pt) and closed by a full stop. L03 to L19 run the full measure (107 to 534 pt); L03, the first line of the chapter, is set in (it begins at 508.9 pt). Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the right margin: they count the lines of the grid of the page (26.7 pt from line to line), with the spaces about the heading and the title: the title stands on the fourth line of the grid and L03 on the sixth; the fifth is empty, and the number 5 stands beside it, under the title (its foot 232.6 pt down); 10, 15 and 20 stand beside L07, L12 and L17. The folio number «f. 121,v.» stands in the left margin beside L07, where the asterisk stands before أَبْطَأَ. Full stops stand on L15 after الشمس and on L18 after المشرِق. The rule over the notes is printed in two pieces (110.8 to 180.3 pt and 183.2 to 210.8 pt, 100 pt in all, with a gap of 2.9 pt); under it stand two notes in one line set in (137.9 to 525.6 pt); no full stop closes the line.

The brackets: a square bracket opens on L03 before مُنْذُ and closes on L04 after والعرض; the note figure 1 stands after the closing bracket. Note 1 says that what is enclosed in the brackets seems out of place to Nallino and is wanting in Plato. The figure 2 stands on L05 after ابدًا: after it the codex adds لما.
The numbers of the kinds, letters in a smaller type under bars: {ov:ا} on L11 (bar 13.1 pt), {ov:ب} on L15, after the full stop (13.8 pt), and {ov:ج} on L18, after the full stop (13.3 pt).

L01 (the heading): no signs; والاربعون without a hamza. L02 (the title): مَعْرِفة: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 2.5 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under the rā' (4.0 x 2.2 pt). الأَشْكال: over the lām-alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (4.0 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the three dots of the shīn (2.5 x 2.9 pt). التِّسْعة: a shadda over the tā', above its two dots (3.2 x 2.5 pt), a kasra under the tā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.5 pt). المتحيِّرة: a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under its two dots (3.6 x 2.2 pt), which stand on the foot of the join of the yā' and the rā'; so too والمتحيِّرة on L03 (3.6 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt) and المتحيِّرة on L10 (3.2 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt).

L03: ولأنّ: the bare hamza over the lām-alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.6 x 2.5 pt). مَدار: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 2.5 pt); so too ومَدار on L04 (3.6 x 2.2 pt). قُطْبَيْ: a damma over the qāf (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the ṭā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the bā' (4.0 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt); so too on L04 (2.5 x 4.7, 2.2 x 2.9, 3.6 x 2.2 and 2.2 x 2.9 pt). فَلَك: a fatha over the fā' and a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 1.8 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt); فلك on L06 and on L10 has no signs. البُروج: a damma over the bā' (2.5 x 5.0 pt); so too on L08 (2.2 x 4.7 pt); البروج on L09 and on L10 has no signs. مُنْذُ: a damma over the mīm (2.2 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the dot of the nūn (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a damma over the dhāl (2.5 x 5.0 pt). عُلِمَتْ: a damma over the ʿayn (2.5 x 5.0 pt), a kasra under the lām (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a fatha low over the mīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the tā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt).

L04: حَرَكتها: a fatha over the ḥā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt); none over the long kāf (compare L05). الكُرَة: a damma over the kāf (2.5 x 5.0 pt) and a short fatha over the rā' (2.5 x 1.8 pt). مُعَدِّل: a damma over the mīm (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a fatha over the ʿayn (3.2 x 1.8 pt), a shadda over the dāl (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under it (3.2 x 1.8 pt); معدِّل on L05 (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt) and on L06 (3.6 x 2.2 pt each) has the shadda and the kasra only. طُلوعها and وغُروبها: a damma over the ṭā' (2.2 x 5.0 pt) and over the ghayn (2.5 x 4.7 pt); so too on L06 (2.5 x 4.7 pt each).

L05: ناحِيَتَيْ: a kasra under the ḥā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the yā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the tā', above it (3.6 x 2.5 pt), and a round sukun over the last yā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt); so too on L06 (3.2 x 2.5, 3.2 x 2.2, 2.9 x 1.8 and 2.5 x 2.5 pt). خَطّ: a fatha over the khā', above its dot (2.9 x 2.2 pt), and a shadda over the ṭā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt); خطّ on L06 has the shadda only (3.6 x 2.2 pt). وَسَط: a fatha over the wāw and a fatha over the sīn, printed joined into one long stroke (7.6 x 3.2 pt); so too on L18 (7.6 x 2.9 pt); on L15 the two fathas stand apart (3.6 x 2.5 and 4.0 x 2.2 pt); وسط on L06 and on L16 has no signs. مُتَسَاوِيَيِ: a damma over the mīm (2.9 x 5.0 pt), a fatha over the tā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the sīn (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a kasra under the wāw (3.2 x 1.8 pt), a fatha over the first yā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the last yā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt). القَدْر: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a round sukun over the dāl (2.2 x 2.9 pt). مَوْضِع: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 2.5 pt), a round sukun over the wāw (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under the ḍād (2.9 x 1.8 pt). ابدًا: the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt); no hamza; the figure 2 follows. يُعْلَمْ: a damma over the yā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the mīm (2.5 x 2.5 pt). لحَرَكَتها: a fatha over the ḥā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), over the rā' (2.9 x 2.2 pt) and over the long kāf (2.9 x 2.2 pt). تَغْيِير: a fatha over the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the dot of the ghayn (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under the first yā', joined to its two dots (3.6 x 4.0 pt together); the two dots of the second yā' stand higher, on the foot of the join of the yā' and the rā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt); so in both copies.

L06: أمّا: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt) and a shadda over the mīm (3.2 x 2.5 pt). الأفْلاك: the bare hamza over the lām-alif (3.2 x 2.9 pt) and a round sukun over the fā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a ring in the second copy. المائلة: the hamza over its tooth (2.5 x 2.9 pt). فإِنّه: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda high over the nūn (3.2 x 2.2 pt).

L07: بالسَّوِيَّة: over the sīn a shadda with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt), a kasra under the wāw (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and over the yā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). بَلْ: a fatha over the bā' (4.0 x 2.9 pt) and a round sukun over the lām (2.5 x 2.9 pt); so too on L09 (3.6 x 2.2 and 2.5 x 2.5 pt). يختلِف: a kasra under the lām (3.6 x 2.2 pt). الجَنُوبيّة: a fatha over the jīm (3.6 x 1.8 pt), a damma over the nūn (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt), without a fatha. أَبْطَأَ: over the first alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the ṭā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and over the last alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.7 pt). طُلوعًا: a damma over the ṭā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt) and the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt). الشَّماليّة: over the shīn, above its three dots, a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt), and a shadda over the yā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt). وكذلك: no signs. تسبِق: a kasra under the bā', joined to its dot (3.6 x 4.0 pt together), in both copies.

L08: بغُروبها: a damma over the ghayn (2.9 x 5.0 pt). كلّ: a shadda over the lām (3.6 x 2.5 pt). يكُنْ: a damma over the kāf (2.9 x 5.0 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the nūn (2.5 x 2.5 pt). نِطاق: a kasra under the nūn (2.9 x 2.2 pt). يَسْتَوِي: a fatha over the yā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.9 pt), a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the wāw (3.6 x 1.8 pt); the last yā' has its two dots. طُلوعه: a damma over the ṭā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt). وغُروبه: a damma over the ghayn (2.9 x 5.0 pt). وتوسُّطه: over the sīn a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.8 pt).

L09: جُزْء: a damma over the jīm (2.5 x 5.0 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the zāy (2.9 x 2.9 pt); the hamza on the line. أجزاء (twice): the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 and 2.9 x 2.9 pt); the last hamza on the line. مختلِفة: a kasra under the lām (3.6 x 1.8 pt); فتختلف has no signs. أشْكالها: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt) and a round sukun over the three dots of the shīn (2.5 x 2.2 pt) (compare the title).

L10: السَّيَّارة: over the sīn a shadda with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt) and over the yā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). نَوَاحي: a fatha over the nūn (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the wāw (3.2 x 1.8 pt); ونواحي later on the line has no signs. الأُفْق: over the lām-alif the hamza with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.1 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt). ايضًا: the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt); so too on L16 (4.0 x 3.6 pt) and on L19 (4.0 x 3.2 pt); no hamza. وأظْهَرها: the bare hamza over the alif (2.5 x 2.9 pt), a round sukun over the ẓā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt), a ring in the second copy, and a fatha over the hā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt).

L11: قُوَّةً: a damma over the qāf (2.5 x 4.7 pt), over the wāw a shadda with a fatha above it (3.6 x 2.2 and 4.0 x 2.2 pt) and the fathatan over the last letter (3.6 x 3.2 pt). فيقَع: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (4.0 x 2.2 pt). تِسْعة: a kasra under the tā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.9 pt). أصناف: the bare hamza over the alif (2.5 x 3.2 pt). فالصَّنْف: over the ṣād a shadda with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the nūn (2.2 x 2.5 pt); no kasra, in both copies; so too والصَّنْف on L15 (3.6 x 4.7 pt; the sukun joined to the dot of the nūn, 3.2 x 5.4 pt together) and on L18 (3.6 x 4.7 and 2.5 x 2.9 pt). الاوّل: a shadda over the wāw (3.2 x 2.5 pt); no hamza. الغَدَوَات: a fatha over the ghayn, over the dāl and over the wāw (3.6 x 2.5, 4.0 x 2.5 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt).

L12: أُفْق: over the alif the hamza with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.1 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt); so too on L19 (3.6 x 6.5 and 2.2 x 2.5 pt). المشرِق: a kasra under the rā' (4.0 x 2.2 pt); so too on L13 (4.0 x 2.2 pt), on L14 (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and on L18 (3.2 x 1.8 pt). وَجْهَيْن: a fatha over the wāw (2.9 x 1.8 pt), a round sukun over the jīm (2.5 x 2.9 pt), a fatha over the hā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt); so too on L16 (3.2 x 2.5, 2.2 x 2.9, 3.6 x 2.2 and 2.5 x 2.9 pt). يُدْعَى: a damma over the yā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the dāl (2.9 x 2.9 pt) and a fatha over the ʿayn (3.2 x 1.8 pt); so too on L13 (2.9 x 4.7, 2.5 x 2.9 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt) and on L16 (2.9 x 5.0, 2.5 x 2.9 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt); the last letter has no dots (compare L17). الصُّبْحِيَّ: over the ṣād a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.1 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a kasra under the ḥā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and over the yā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.6 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt); the yā' has its two dots. اذا and احدهما: no hamza.

L13: أن: the bare hamza over the alif (3.2 x 3.2 pt); so too twice on L17 (3.2 x 3.2 and 2.9 x 3.2 pt), on L18 (2.9 x 3.2 pt) and on L19 (2.9 x 3.2 pt) (compare L14). غيْرَ: a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt), a ring in the second copy, and a fatha over the rā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt); no fatha over the ghayn. ثمّ: a shadda over the mīm (3.2 x 2.5 pt). يطلُع: a damma over the lām, joined to the top of the letter in the master scan; so too on L14. بَعْدِ: a fatha over the bā' (3.6 x 2.9 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under the dāl (3.6 x 2.5 pt); بَعْد later on the line has the fatha (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and the sukun (2.9 x 2.9 pt) and no kasra; بعد on L17 has no signs. طُلوع: a damma over the ṭā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt); so too on L15 (2.9 x 4.7 pt) and on L17 (2.5 x 5.0 pt). والآخر: the madda over the lām-alif and no other sign; so too on L17.

L14: صُبْحِيَّ: a damma over the ṣād (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.9 x 2.9 pt), a kasra under the ḥā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and over the yā' a shadda with a fatha above it in one cluster (4.0 x 4.7 pt). مَشْرِقٍ: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 2.5 pt), a round sukun over the three dots of the shīn (2.9 x 2.9 pt), a kasra under the rā', joined to the foot of the letter in the master scan and apart from it in the second copy, and under the qāf a double stroke (4.0 x 3.2 pt). أنْ: the bare hamza over the alif (3.2 x 3.2 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the nūn (2.9 x 2.9 pt). يُقال: a damma over the yā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt); so too on L18 (2.5 x 4.7 pt). طلَع: a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 2.5 pt). قَبْلَ: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (4.0 x 2.5 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a fatha over the lām (4.3 x 2.9 pt).

L15: يُسَمَّى: a damma over the yā' (2.9 x 5.0 pt), a fatha over the sīn (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and over the mīm a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.5 pt); the last letter has no dots. سَماء: a fatha over the sīn (3.2 x 2.2 pt); the hamza on the line.

L16: فَوْقِ: a fatha over the fā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the wāw (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under the qāf (4.0 x 2.2 pt). وتَحْتِها: a fatha over the first tā' (4.0 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the ḥā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under the second tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). صُبْحِيًّا: a damma over the ṣād (2.9 x 5.0 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.9 x 2.9 pt), a kasra under the ḥā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and over the yā' a shadda with the fathatan above it in one cluster (4.0 x 5.4 pt); so too on L17 (2.5 x 4.7, 2.2 x 2.5 and 2.9 x 1.8 pt; the shadda 3.2 x 2.2 pt and the fathatan 3.6 x 3.2 pt apart). الارض: no hamza.

L17: يتوسَّط: over the sīn a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). يُدعَى: a damma over the yā' (2.9 x 5.0 pt) and a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.2 pt); no sukun over the dāl, in both copies (compare L12). مُتَوَسِّطًا: a damma over the mīm (2.2 x 4.7 pt), a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the wāw (4.0 x 2.5 pt), a shadda over the sīn (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under it (3.6 x 1.8 pt), and the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt).
L18: الصُّبْح: over the ṣād a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.1 pt) and a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). تغريب: no signs.

L19: المطلَع: the word is printed with two upright strokes after the loop of the ṭā', its stem and a lām whose foot runs on to the ʿayn, and no alif, in both copies; a short fatha over that lām (2.5 x 1.8 pt). قَريب: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.5 pt). المغرِب: a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). وُجُوه: a damma over the wāw (2.2 x 4.3 pt) and a damma over the jīm (2.2 x 4.7 pt). شَتَّى: a fatha over the three dots of the shīn (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt); the last letter has no dots.
